model.architecture: Ovis2.5 is a SOTA-for-size vision-language model with a structural-embedding vision path: a Siglip2 NaViT encoder feeds a visual tokenizer that turns each image patch-group into a probability distribution over a 65 536-word visual vocabulary, then embeds it; the language decoder is Qwen3-1.7B.

variants.quantization: Decoder Qwen3-1.7B int4 weights (symmetric, blockwise-32 + OCTAV optimal-clipping), input embedding INT8 (externalized section); Siglip2-NaViT encoder + visual-tokenizer int8 weights; integer compute

recommended.reason: the Android path verified on a Galaxy S26 (S4 gate 2026-08-25): full delegation (3840 ops across 3 subgraphs) and a correct answer to the probe; 28.3 tok/s decode, engine init 5.0 s, peak 820 MB. No same-device CPU control was taken, so this is the verified choice for the class, not a measured win over CPU

platform_notes: Reasoning VLM: may emit a <think>...</think> block before the final answer (matches the base model); allow enough max-tokens (>=1024) for the answer to follow.

iPhone 17 Pro figures (~20 tok/s CPU, ~45 tok/s GPU, single-image VQA) are stated expectations carried from the InternVL3.5-2B build, not measurements of this build; the card recommends independent on-device measurement before quoting exact numbers.
Vision-only bundle (no audio tower): bring up the engine with the vision modality only; requesting the audio tower (.all) fails at session creation.
Ovis's two learned image-boundary indicator embeddings are omitted (the fast_vlm path splices only the atom embeddings); verified to stay coherent in eager.
int8 vision weights keep end-to-end correlation ~0.99 against the reference.
Galaxy S26 GPU gate prompt carries no image: it covers engine creation and the text path only; the vision path on the GPU is not measured there.
Galaxy S26 GPU gate: XNNPACK additionally takes 1 of the 4 nodes in `main`; the runtime accepts that split.
2026-08-28 start_token fix (metadata-only, weights unchanged): the literal start token "None" was removed. Accuracy figures on the card were measured on the previous file and not re-measured.

2026-08-30 tokenizer section replaced with the upstream tokenizer.json (weights unchanged): answers to prompts with accented letters/symbols/emoji can change; accuracy figures and any on-device rows were measured on the previous file; the on-device gate has not been re-run.

2026-08-31 chat template fix (metadata-only, weights unchanged): history turns with role 'assistant' are now accepted; single-turn renders, token ids, prefill counts and greedy answers are unchanged, so the card's numbers still describe this file.
